events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A free café-inspired CHANEL fragrance experience for COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU with personalized fragrance discovery, the wider COCO MADEMOISELLE line, makeup and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free public admission and fragrance/beauty discovery; CHANEL says complementary hair and body products are part of the experience. Promotional products are subject to availability.
events.caveats: CHANEL's live event page says appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. An appointment is therefore optional rather than a condition of public admission; capacity can still affect walk-in entry.
events.practical_notes: Second weekend remains upcoming: Friday September 18, noon–7 PM; Saturday September 19 and Sunday September 20, 10 AM–7 PM. Free and open to the public; appointments recommended, walk-ins welcome.

events.address: The High Line above Little West 12th Street, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: Bvlgari's first public art installation in the United States: a monumental golden pneumatic sculpture by Plastique Fantastique created for the New York chapter of Serpenti Infinito.
events.what_is_free: Free public access to the outdoor auruBOROS installation on the High Line.
events.caveats: Bvlgari's official video identifies the High Line and September 10–20 run. Current coverage confirms the installation itself is free and open to everyone. It is an outdoor public-art installation rather than the private launch reception that preceded it.
events.practical_notes: On view through Sunday September 20 on the High Line above Little West 12th Street. No RSVP or ticket is required. Visit during High Line public park hours; September seasonal park hours are 7 AM–11 PM.
